purpose: Connect religious lineage origins and later diffusion events to the World Map without collapsing a religion into a modern country or treating an origin place as present-day ownership.

map_contract.origin_anchor: Use a point or region only when historically meaningful and sufficiently specific.
map_contract.distributed_origin: Use a region/band or no point when formation was distributed.
map_contract.diffusion: Later spread must be represented by dated events/routes/regions, not by expanding the origin point.
map_contract.present_demography: Country affiliation shares come only from world-religion-layer and its dated sources.
map_contract.no_geopolitical_bloc: A religious tradition is never automatically an alliance, political alignment or state identity.
map_contract.minority_rule: Map presence without implying uniformity, loyalty or belief intensity.

next_diffusion_layers: Christianity: Judea/eastern Mediterranean → Roman world → Europe/Africa/Asia → global missionary/diaspora expansions by period.
Islam: Hijaz → Near East/North Africa/Persia/Central and South Asia → Southeast Asia/Africa/Europe/global diaspora by dated phases.
Jewish lineages: ancient Israel/Judah → Babylonian and Mediterranean diasporas → medieval regional centers → modern global distributions.
Buddhism: north India → Sri Lanka/Central Asia/China/Southeast Asia/Tibet/Japan with school-specific dates.
Hindu traditions: South Asian regional formations and diaspora; avoid one-point origin when evidence is distributed.
Sikhism: Punjab → global diaspora; distinguish sacred/institutional centers from population distribution.
Baháʼí: Shiraz/Baghdad/Akka-Haifa trajectory plus later global administrative/community spread.
